## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One critical defect needs fixing: the containment check in `preview` compares paths as text without resolving them, so a relative path containing `..` gets past the check and the function reads files outside the home directory. This review read `app/paths.py` and `tests/test_paths.py` at the PR head in full, plus the added `tests/review-note.txt` through the diff, and followed `preview` from its input to `read_text`. The review found no project policy files, because the manifest is empty. This review read the tests but did not run them.

## Changes
The PR adds `preview(home, relative)` to `app/paths.py`, which returns the first 200 characters of a file only when the path falls under `home`, and `settings_file(home)`, which returns `home/settings.toml`. It adds tests for both helpers and a one-line text file, `tests/review-note.txt`.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before the home containment check — `preview(home, "../secret.txt")` reads `secret.txt` from the parent of `home` instead of raising `ValueError`. `Path.is_relative_to` only compares path parts as text: `Path(home) / "../secret.txt"` becomes `home/../secret.txt`, which still begins with `home`'s parts, so the check passes and line 14 reads the file outside home. A symlink inside `home` that points elsewhere also gets past the check for the same reason. The only rejection case in the test, at `tests/test_paths.py:20`, uses an absolute path, which `/` swaps in whole, so that test cannot catch this bypass. — Any caller that passes a user-supplied relative path can read the first 200 characters of any file the process can access, which defeats the only purpose of the check. — Fix: Compare `(Path(home) / relative).resolve()` against `Path(home).resolve()` with `is_relative_to`, and read the resolved path. Add test cases for `"../outside.txt"` and for a symlink inside `home` that points outside it.
